request.style: English, male voice, solo, acoustic guitar, flute, soft percussion, warm and reflective, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Abraham took another wife
Her name was Keturah
She bore him Zimran first
With five other sons named
Jokshan Medan and Midian
Ishbak and Shuah

[Chorus]
Everything to Isaac
But gifts to the rest
Sent away eastward
Away from the west

[Verse]
While he was still alive
He sent them to the land
Where the sun rises early
Far from Isaac's hand

[Chorus]
Everything to Isaac
But gifts to the rest
Sent away eastward
Away from the west

[Bridge]
Abraham breathed his last
Old and satisfied with life
Gathered to his people
His days were done

[Outro]
Isaac and Ishmael
Buried him in the cave
In the field of Ephron
Facing Mamre
